name: claude-simple
description: A lean Claude Code setup for Go + Nuxt/TypeScript + TiDB teams, distilled from a production monorepo and from what survived cost-per-fix measurement.

plugins.name: simple
plugins.description: Agents, skills, hooks, a statusline and a one-command project setup for working on Go + Nuxt/TypeScript + TiDB codebases with fewer tokens: grep-first navigation, lean workflow workers, a guard against reading huge files, a delivery gate, and the method for measuring a plugin before adopting it.
